messages:
Maya Singh: FYI AcmeEdge reached out. They want to include an open checkpoint in a Marketplace VM image and need a redistribution grant from us + provenance. Can we do this?
Tom Alvarez: Do we know the upstream license? that's the first gate.
Maya Singh: They claim "PermissiveAI v1" but sent only a download link. Asking us to attest origin and sign a small redistribution addendum.
Rachelle Kim: Legal + ops checklist proposal:
- upstream license text
- weights checksum (sha256)
- provenance.json signed by Redwood key
- quantized artifact (int8) + reference full-precision artifact for audits
- small smoke test (one prompt + expected hash)
- marketplace TOS snippet that prohibits re-redistribution

LegalBot: Immediate asks: attach license verbatim and evidence of upstream authorship. If license permits redistribution, require partner warranty in writing. If there are any "non-commercial" or "no-derivatives" clauses, it's a no-go. Also flag export control review.
OpsBot: From infra: we require container signing (cosign) and a CI gate that verifies provenance before publishing. Also recommend the image include a README with isolation recommendations.
Tom Alvarez: For GTM: propose free listing + paid integration/support. Keep announcement text conservative - no latency/cost claims unless benchmarked.
Maya Singh: Action items:
- AcmeEdge to provide upstream license + weights checksum (today)
- Legal to confirm redistribution OK (48h)
- Ops to produce signing + verification steps (72h)
- Marketing/GTM hold on public announcement until legal clearance

Rachelle Kim: I'll draft the minimal addendum language for partner warranty and a sample provenance.json template.
LegalBot: Attach the license here once you have it. We will respond with redlines and the wording we require in the marketplace TOS.
Maya Singh: Thanks all, will ping when artifacts arrive. :wave:
